provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Jor’maelis is centered at -46.374220, 130.627031 under Communalism, with 105,431,000 people across 13 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Jor’maelis occupies 10,194,632.18 sq mi / 26,403,976.13 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 5.176582% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Underwater without reefs, Beach and grass with water and Partial forest define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Ocean Surface floating settlement, Beach and grass with water, Underwater without reefs, Partial forest and Farming. Population density is 3.993 people/sq km / 10.342 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Triton, Merfolk, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Nefaric Veil, with worship and patronage records naming Nefarokir, Eirzunet, Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Sigrananna, Bastveig, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 6 recorded four-province geography group links, including 5 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

A low-pressure sea storm arriving with a strong moon tide.
A sudden retreat of water before trench-fed surge returns.
A black-green wall of rain that crosses whole coasts.

Moonlit fog so bright it makes ships look closer than they are.

npcs.name: Daisy Ashpetal
npcs.description: Daisy Ashpetal is a Reborn bookseller with old grief in her bones and a shop full of maps, ration guides, children's primers, banned memoirs, and things she insists are not sentimental. She has survived enough eras to know the difference between danger and loneliness, so she quietly helps mercenaries, refugees, and investigators find leads when official channels have failed them. Daisy is dry, kind, and impossible to impress, but she remembers every person who tried to become better and every city that punished them for it.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Ish’voryk is a Town in Jor’maelis, under Communalism, with severe danger, Underwater without reefs terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Triton, Merfolk, Locathah, Tamhiogal, Dril'thar — Ocean. Reborn reads through the Elementborn entry of the race compendium, within Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples, marked by Horundar. The local form is read through Azureborn. Elementborn are people shaped by a dominant environmental or elemental birth-state. In Belavadös, Ashborn, Azureborn, Bogborn, Deepborn, Snowborn, and Stoneborn are lineages of one Elementborn parent race. Table cues: Elementborn Lineage, Environmental Birth-State, Terrain Adaptation; starting tendency Neutral - Neutral - Neutral - Neutral.
rumors: Daisy's rarest books are not on shelves; they are names she only gives to people desperate enough to deserve them.
She once sent a scout after a cure lead with nothing but a map, a blessing, and a warning not to die stupid.
plotHooks: Daisy asks the party to recover a stolen children's book whose margins contain a hidden refugee route.
An old customer returns unchanged after decades, and Daisy knows that means someone has been tampering with death or time.
